sentences: For `image_load_mip` with `a16`, the first VGPR holds unsigned X (low half) and Y (high half).
The low half of the second VGPR selects the mip and its high half is unused.
Both ordinary and D16 results use the same address.
LLVM gfx1030 assembles both forms in `tests/semantic/fixtures/packed_mip_load_2d.asm`.

`tests/test_image_load_typed.py` checks the texel and mip operands of the float, UINT and SINT fetches, including noncontiguous address registers. [AMD RDNA 2 ISA, MIMG A16 field](https://www.amd.com/content/dam/amd/en/documents/radeon-tech-docs/instruction-set-architectures/rdna2-shader-instruction-set-architecture.pdf)
